title: VoxSafeBench: Not Just What Is Said, but Who, How, and Where
abstract: arXiv:2604.14548v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As speech language models (SLMs) transition from personal devices into shared, multi-user environments, their responses must account for far more than the words alone. Who is speaking, how they sound, and where the conversation takes place can each turn an otherwise benign request into one that is unsafe, unfair, or privacy-violating. Existing benchmarks, however, largely focus on basic audio comprehension, study individual risks in isolation, or conflate content that is inherently harmful with content that only becomes problematic due to its acoustic context. We introduce VoxSafeBench, among the first benchmarks to jointly evaluate social alignment in SLMs across three dimensions: safety, fairness, and privacy. translated_title: VoxSafeBench：不仅仅是说了什么，还有谁在说、怎么说、在哪里说
translated_abstract: 随着语音语言模型（SLMs）从个人设备过渡到共享的多用户环境，它们的响应必须考虑的远不止语言文字本身。谁在说话、他们听起来如何、以及对话发生的地点，每一个因素都可能将一个原本无害的请求转变为不安全、不公平或侵犯隐私的请求。然而，现有的基准测试主要关注基础的音频理解、孤立地研究单个风险，或者将本质上有害的内容与仅因声学语境而变得有问题的内容混为一谈。我们提出了VoxSafeBench，这是首批在安全性、公平性和隐私三个维度上联合评估语音语言模型社会对齐能力的基准之一。VoxSafeBench采用双层设计：第一层使用匹配的文本和音频输入评估以内容为中心的风险，而第二层则针对音频条件下的风险，即转录文本本身无害、但恰当的响应取决于音频上下文的情况。
tldr: VoxSafeBench是首批从安全性、公平性和隐私三个维度联合评估语音语言模型社会对齐能力的基准，采用双层设计分别评估以内容为中心的风险和音频条件下的风险。
en_tdlr: VoxSafeBench is among the first benchmarks to jointly evaluate social alignment in speech language models across safety, fairness, and privacy dimensions, using a two-tier design to assess both content-centric and audio-conditioned risks.
